encoding.interpretation: Decode texels before interpolation. Compare decoded output to clipped raw reconstruction separately from clipping loss. Whole-output metrics weight stored texels equally; sparse directional probes may miss clipped highlights. RMSE components are not additive; no claim of prefilter reference convergence.

history.interpretation: Decoded RGBD mip-zero resampling of a continuous direction field at fixed axes/edges/corners/uniform/local probes. Includes projection and quantization error; not an optimization gain, general radiometric proof, or full historical quality matrix.

optional_hdr_reference.limitation: Bounded diagnostics, not strict error bounds; unresolved primary or local checks remain unqualified

tail.interpretation: Direct prefilter texels versus closed-form integral; ideal output-grid reconstruction; actual final sampling. These RMSE values are not additive.
